note: In-scope computational modules per language. Every upstream symbol whose module is NOT listed here is N/A-by-design (na_category below) and counts as accounted; symbols in these modules that are not yet claimed by a capability form the honest BACKLOG (the pure-LOGOS parity surface still to land). This is what lets backlog->0 mean 'every deterministic, memory-safe, pure-LOGOS capability landed' rather than 'mirrored every OS syscall'.
na_category: Out-of-scope BY DESIGN for a deterministic, memory-safe, pure-LOGOS stdlib whose whole value is cross-tier byte-identity: OS/platform (os, posix, syscall, socket, net*, curses, tty, termios, signal, threads, fcntl, resource, pwd, grp, winreg, msvcrt), heavy IO/DB/networking stacks (stdio file IO, sqlite3, dbm, database/sql, http*, ftplib/smtplib/imaplib, urllib, ssl, crypto/tls, crypto/x509), reflection/introspection/compiler-internals (reflect, inspect, typing, ast, dis, tokenize, symtable, go/ast, go/types, go/parser, sre_parse/sre_compile/sre_constants regex internals, debug/*), GUI/media/graphics (tkinter, turtle, image, audioop, wave, ossaudiodev), serialization/interchange frameworks (pickle, marshal, shelve, xml*, email, plistlib), async/concurrency runtimes (asyncio, threading, concurrent, contextvars, runtime, sync), unsafe/FFI (ctypes, cffi, unsafe, cgo, plugin), and testing/tooling (unittest, doctest, pdb, profile, timeit, testing, argparse, logging). None of these can be deterministic pure-LOGOS byte-identical capabilities; they are covered (where LOGOS offers them at all) by logicaffeine_system, not the parity gate.

na_categories.covered_seq: capability covered by LOGOS's value-semantic Seq + iter.lg/sort.lg/heap.lg (the language's list/slice/deque method surface is not mirrored 1:1)
na_categories.covered_map: covered by LOGOS Map + collections.lg (dictionary capability present; per-language method names not mirrored)
na_categories.covered_iter: covered by `Repeat for` + iter.lg (map/filter/reduce/…); LOGOS has no lazy-iterator objects
na_categories.covered_text: covered by LOGOS Text + strings.lg/chars.lg (string capability present; method surface not mirrored)
na_categories.covered_set: covered by LOGOS Set + iter.lg set algebra
na_categories.covered_int: covered by math.lg + LOGOS's arbitrary-precision, overflow-checked Int (checked/wrapping/euclid variants are the default behavior)
na_categories.covered_cmp: covered by LOGOS comparison operators + iter.lg min/max/sort
na_categories.covered_hof: reduce/partial covered by iter.lg + closures; caching/dispatch is a runtime framework concern
na_categories.covered_valuetype: covered by the corresponding LOGOS value type (Int/Real/Bool/Text/Seq/Map/Set) and its operators; the Python object-method surface is not mirrored
na_categories.covered_stats_reexport: a statistics-module re-export of a capability covered elsewhere (math funcs, Counter, struct-return)
na_categories.covered_java: a Java method surface for a capability LOGOS provides via py/rust/go-shared equivalents (collections/text/math/Optional/stream)
na_categories.temporal_covered: covered by LOGOS temporal types (Date/Moment/Span/Duration) + exposed temporal builtins; the Go/py object method surface is not mirrored 1:1
na_categories.bignum_native: LOGOS `Int` is natively arbitrary-precision; big.Int/Float/Rat object methods & serialization are not mirrored as methods (arithmetic is native and covered)
na_categories.framework_class: a stateful/OOP framework class (formatter/context/etc.); the underlying capability is covered functionally where it exists
na_categories.streaming_object: streaming/object-model JSON; LOGOS covers JSON via whole-value jsonParse/jsonSerialize
na_categories.enum_machinery: LOGOS models enumerations with inductive/sum types; Python's Enum class machinery is a different OOP mechanism
na_categories.mutable_container: LOGOS collections are value-semantic; in-place mutation is covered by functional operations that return a new value
na_categories.object_model: object subscription/attribute/identity/matmul operators; not applicable to LOGOS's value model
na_categories.reflection: LOGOS is statically typed and compiled; runtime introspection/reflection does not apply
na_categories.dynamic_exec: no runtime code evaluation in a compiled, deterministic language
na_categories.interactive_io: interactive/console IO; LOGOS uses Show + native file.lg for deterministic IO
na_categories.iterator_protocol: LOGOS iterates with `Repeat for`; no explicit iterator-protocol objects
na_categories.error_type: an exception TYPE, not a capability; LOGOS surfaces failure via Result
na_categories.float_bits: raw IEEE-754 bit reinterpretation of a float — a memory-representation detail, not a numeric capability
na_categories.locale: locale-dependent behavior is explicitly out of scope (LOGOS is locale-independent by design)
na_categories.native_clock: non-deterministic wall/monotonic clock or timer — excluded from the cross-tier byte-identity contract by design
na_categories.raw_runtime: raw C memory/process/signal primitive — memory-unsafe, out of scope by design
na_categories.raw_memory: raw memory manipulation / fixed-layout array — out of scope for a memory-safe value language
na_categories.static_typing: static type-system / type-hint machinery — native to LOGOS, not a library
na_categories.abc_machinery: abstract-base-class machinery — not applicable to LOGOS
na_categories.type_hierarchy: numeric abstract-base-class hierarchy — LOGOS has the concrete value types directly
na_categories.regex_flag: a regex compilation flag/mode constant; LOGOS regex is a single fixed dialect without configurable flags
na_categories.module_constant: a module-level numeric/string constant, version marker, or internal datum, not a callable capability
na_categories.format_string: a helper for struct's packing format-string DSL (size/offset/streaming over a format); LOGOS packs integers with explicit width + endianness arguments (packUintBE/LE, unpackUintBE/LE) instead of a format mini-language
na_categories.single_float: a 32-bit float (float32) specific operation; LOGOS's Real is IEEE-754 double precision with no distinct single-precision type
